name: 杨国福麻辣烫 Yang Guo Fu Ma La Tang
reviews:
The kids enjoy making their own choices of ingredients. Lots of options here which are kept fresh in the fridge system. The spicy soup isn’t too spicy and even is a little bland. Large bowls are good value and can be shared between two.

Also great value are the two-for-price-of-one drinks from the front counter which also sells desserts like egg waffles!

do not be fooled by the reviews. this place is extremely overpriced and there are definitely cheaper malatang places elsewhere for the same quality. went here with a bunch of friends and we were all surprised at how much our food costed - this small bowl of noodles costed over $30. condiments bar had a limited range and overall the quality and range of ingredients was quite average.

definitely better malatang places elsewhere

Came back to the restaurant on April 30th with the same group of friends. I’ve noticed a big improvement in the hygiene, definitely better than I expected. This time, no stomach issues at all. I’ll leave my previous review up as a reflection of my past experience and to show how things are changing for the better. -April 2025

Today is the 4th day of me having to deal with diarrhoea, nausea and headache. - March 2025

A good range of ingredients and the broth is nice. I got the spicy broth, it was nice. It wasn’t as spicy as I had expected but adding a bit of chilli sauce made it just right. The tables were a bit sticky and could be wiped down a bit better.
Nice place to visit with reasonable price. I had a Mala soup and did not try the fried Mala. The kitchen has made mistakes of my friend’s order. Here they provide lots of space.
